description: An eight delay line reverb, ported from the Csound reverbsc opcode

params.text: Sets the frequency above which the repeats are damped away, 128Hz to 16384Hz as a power of two
Sets how much of the reverb is fed back into itself, 0 to 1; higher settings give a longer tail
Sets how far the delay lines are wobbled in pitch, 0 to 6, which breaks up the ringing of the tail
Sets how much reverb is heard against the untouched signal, 0 to 1

inputs.text: The left signal to be reverberated
The right signal to be reverberated; with nothing patched here the left signal is used for both

outputs.text: The left signal mixed with the reverb
The right signal mixed with the reverb

notes: nothing is computed and neither output is written until a cable is patched into InL
turning PM changes nothing until the knob is let go, when the delay lines are built again at the new setting

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the InL jack.
